skill.name: web3-data
skill.description: Query EVM blockchain data through the Chainbase CLI, including tokens, wallets, transactions, ENS, DeFi positions, and custom SQL. Explore crypto narratives, topics, posts, and mentions through the Chainbase Tops service.
skill.summary: A Chainbase CLI workflow for EVM on-chain analytics and crypto social intelligence.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: All 96 static matches are false positives because they identify documentation links, API reference tables, environment-variable configuration, or literal CLI examples. The skill does describe an optional x402 private-key payment flow, which is a medium-risk financial side effect that requires explicit user approval and controlled credentials.

remediation.issue: The x402 workflow can authorize pay-per-call micropayments with a configured private key.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before using --x402, display the expected charge, and use a narrowly funded wallet or payment key.

remediation.issue: The skill uses Chainbase API credentials through CLI configuration or CHAINBASE_API_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Remove demo credentials from distributed defaults, document secret storage, and avoid printing keys in command output or logs.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs an agent to run external Chainbase commands and user-derived SQL.
remediation.suggestion: Use argument-safe process execution, validate addresses and options, constrain SQL to read-only queries, and require approval for unusual commands.

content.user_title: Explore Web3 Data and Crypto Trends
content.value_statement: Blockchain data is spread across many endpoints and chains, making focused analysis slow. This skill routes requests through Chainbase CLI and Tops to return structured on-chain and crypto-social insights.
actual_capabilities: Query token metadata, prices, holders, balances, transfers, and transaction histories.
Inspect DeFi portfolio positions and resolve ENS or Space ID names.
Run custom read-oriented SQL queries against supported chain datasets.
Track trending crypto topics, topic details, posts, and keyword mentions through Tops.
Format returned blockchain and social data into tables, summaries, and key observations.
limitations: Results depend on Chainbase and Tops availability, coverage, rate limits, and data freshness.
The skill does not independently verify token legitimacy, ownership, market risk, or social-post accuracy.
Custom SQL requires valid schemas, supported chains, and queries within provider result limits.
x402 requests can incur charges and require separate user approval and payment credentials.

use_cases.title: Investigate Token Distribution
use_cases.description: Compare token metadata, current price, transfers, and top holders across an EVM chain before preparing a research brief.

use_cases.title: Review Wallet Activity
use_cases.description: Summarize balances, transaction history, DeFi positions, and ENS records for a wallet address supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Monitor Crypto Narratives
use_cases.description: Find trending topics, inspect representative posts, and summarize recent mentions for a project or market theme.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Token Lookup
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the current price, metadata, and top holders for [TOKEN] on [CHAIN]. Ask for the contract address if the symbol is ambiguous.

prompt_templates.title: Wallet Activity Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: For wallet [ADDRESS] on [CHAIN], summarize native balance, token balances, recent transactions, DeFi positions, and ENS names. Use clear tables.

prompt_templates.title: Narrative Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Track [PROJECT OR KEYWORD] through Tops. Find related topics, inspect recent posts, and summarize sentiment, recurring claims, and notable accounts without treating posts as verified facts.

prompt_templates.title: Custom On-Chain Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a read-only Chainbase SQL query for [QUESTION] on [CHAIN]. Explain the tables, filters, joins, time range, and expected fields before execution, then report limitations.

output_examples.input: Show the top holders of a specified token on Ethereum.
output_examples.output: A ranked table with wallet addresses, token balances, estimated values when available, and a note about the query timestamp and coverage.

output_examples.input: What is trending around a specified crypto theme?
output_examples.output: A concise narrative report with topic rank, heat or score, keywords, representative posts, recurring claims, and a clear distinction between signals and verified facts.

output_examples.input: Query recent transfers for a contract.
output_examples.output: A filtered transfer table with block or timestamp, sender, recipient, amount, transaction hash, chain, and any data freshness or pagination caveats.

best_practices: Provide the chain and contract or wallet address whenever possible.
Use JSON output for structured analysis and state the query time and provider limits.
Treat social signals as leads, verify important claims independently, and approve any paid request first.
anti_patterns: Do not infer token safety, investment value, or identity from balances or social popularity alone.
Do not run broad or write-capable queries when a narrow read-only query answers the question.
Do not expose API keys or private payment keys in prompts, reports, logs, or screenshots.

faq.question: Which chains are supported?
faq.answer: The documented examples include Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, and zkSync. Availability depends on provider coverage.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Chainbase Web3 data uses a configured API key or the documented demo fallback. Tops is documented as not requiring an API key.

faq.question: Can it find a contract address?
faq.answer: It can use token metadata lookup when an address is available. Ask the user to confirm the chain and address when a name is ambiguous.

faq.question: Can it run custom SQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can translate a supported read-oriented question into Chainbase SQL and report query limits and schema assumptions.

faq.question: Can it analyze crypto social activity?
faq.answer: Yes. Tops supports trending topics, topic details, posts, narrative search, and recent mentions for keywords or projects.

faq.question: Does it make blockchain transactions?
faq.answer: The documented workflows query data. The optional x402 flag can incur service micropayments, but the skill does not document wallet transaction signing.
